title: Group Room Blocks Rider: Reduction Percentage for Early Reductions
content:
On Group Room Blocks, the reduction percentage of a reduction addendum's free-reduction allowance follows how early the reduction comes and how the signing deposit was paid.

### The rule

- When the days before arrival of the reduction are **180 or more** and the signing deposit entry on the block ledger is dated no more than the block type's signing-deposit period of calendar days after the proposal date, the reduction percentage is the block type's free-reduction percentage **times 2**.
- When those days are **at least 120 but fewer than 180** and the signing deposit entry is so dated, it is the free-reduction percentage **times 1.5**.
- In every other case, including a block with no signing deposit entry, it is the block type's **free-reduction percentage**.

### Signing-deposit period that decides whether the entry is on time

| Block type | Signing deposit entry dated no more than this many calendar days after the proposal date |
|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 7 |
| Wedding Room Block | 7 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 3 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 0 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 0 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 0 |

### Combinations

| Days before arrival of the reduction | Signing deposit entry on time | Reduction percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 180 or more | Yes | free-reduction percentage times 2 |
| 180 or more | No, or no entry | free-reduction percentage |
| 120 to 179 | Yes | free-reduction percentage times 1.5 |
| 120 to 179 | No, or no entry | free-reduction percentage |
| fewer than 120 | any | free-reduction percentage |

Boundaries: 180 days falls in the top band and 179 in the middle band; 120 days falls in the middle band and 119 below it.

### Resulting percentages by block type

| Block type | Free-reduction percentage | Times 2 | Times 1.5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 10 | 20 | 15 |
| Wedding Room Block | 10 | 20 | 15 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 20 | 40 | 30 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 15 | 30 | 22.5 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 10 | 20 | 15 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 5 | 10 | 7.5 |

**Example (hypothetical Wedding Room Block).** The signing deposit entry is dated 7 calendar days after the proposal date, on time; a reduction 150 days before arrival takes 15 percent. Had the entry been dated 8 days after the proposal date, the same reduction would take 10 percent.
